title: Shop and city-service artwork placement specification
status: Proposed integration map; source assets inspected, application routes and backend bindings not verified.
routingRule: Reuse established equivalent routes and stable database IDs; migrate presentation bindings rather than duplicating systems.
runtimeRule: Use explicit source filenames; no array-position or guessed-slug filename matching. The web-ready archive omits PNG masters.

locations.name: Ironline Armory
locations.primaryPlacement: Weapon-shop page: display this hero above the weapon catalog, ammunition filters, and purchase controls. Use the emblem for the Foundry Ward marker and equipment-resupply links.
locations.specialRule: Keep individual weapon thumbnails separate; this banner is the shop identity, not an item image.

placements.sidebar: emblem only where appropriate navigation already exists
